newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture said Monday that 20 percent of the U.S. corn crop had been harvested, compared to 14 percent a week ago and the five-year average of 34 percent.
USDA said 40 percent of soybeans were harvested. A week ago, 17 percent were in the bin and the five-year average is 52 percent.
The department rated 2 percent of the corn crop in very poor condition, 7 percent poor, 25 percent fair, 48 percent good and 18 percent excellent.
The department pegged 2 percent of the soybean crop in very poor condition, 8 percent poor, 30 percent fair, 46 percent good and 14 percent excellent.
USDA said 35 percent of the cotton crop was harvested versus 25 percent last week, and 35 percent average.
It said 44 percent of the winter wheat crop had emerged, compared to 28 percent a year ago and 46 percent average.
